title: Interference-Driven Clustered Optimisation for FM Spectrum Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2609.21441v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-border FM spectrum coordination involves protecting foreign broadcasting services while preserving domestic coverage, amid increasingly large radio-planning datasets containing thousands of transmitters and millions of transmitter-pixel relationships. In such scenarios, conventional optimisation approaches become computationally demanding due to the high dimensionality of the associated power-control problem. This paper proposes an interference-driven clustered optimisation framework for large-scale FM spectrum coordination. The proposed method exploits the observation that violations of foreign-service protection are typically dominated by a limited subset of transmitters. Protected services are therefore analysed to identify dominant interferers and quantify their impact on interference. translated_title: 面向FM频谱协调的干扰驱动聚类优化方法
translated_abstract: 跨境FM频谱协调涉及在保护外国广播服务的同时保持本国覆盖范围，而无线电规划数据集日益庞大，包含数千个发射机和数百万个发射机-像素关系。在这种情况下，由于相关功率控制问题的高维性，传统优化方法的计算成本变得非常高。本文提出了一种用于大规模FM频谱协调的干扰驱动聚类优化框架。该方法利用了一个观察结果：对外国服务保护的违规通常仅由有限的发射机子集主导。因此，通过对受保护服务进行分析来识别主要干扰源，并量化其对干扰的影响。这些关系通过干扰图来表示，并从中提取面向优化的发射机集群。
tldr: 本文提出一种干扰驱动的聚类优化框架，通过构建干扰图识别对跨境FM频谱保护违规起主导作用的发射机集群，从而显著降低大规模功率控制问题的计算复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interference-driven clustered optimisation framework that identifies dominant interfering transmitters via an interference graph, significantly reducing the computational complexity of large-scale cross-border FM spectrum coordination.
